steps.u: Our handlers all repeat the same try/catch that maps errors to HTTP responses. Centralise it in the Express app.

steps.a: I moved the error mapping into one error middleware plus a wrap() helper and converted deals.ts as the first handler; its 12 tests pass. The other 10 handlers still have their own try/catch and the middleware is not registered in app.ts yet, so right now deals.ts errors would fall back to Express's default handler.

reference.summary: Created a central Express error middleware and a wrap helper for async handlers, and converted the deals handler to use them; its 12 tests pass. The other handlers are unconverted and the middleware is not yet registered in the app, so the change is incomplete.
facts: error middleware created mapping NotFound to 404, Invalid to 422, else 500
